original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 0 System BIOS Minor Release component matches the approved numeric release contract and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete Type 0 with a version-bound rendering of the BIOS revision components, extract the minor component without treating it as a decimal fraction or text suffix, compare to the approved value, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected minor component and plan. The component read, reboot and persistence check are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected minor-release numeric value including leading-zero semantics
safety_requirements: Preserve raw output/errors and verify combined-revision parsing.
Treat major/minor as discrete components; do not parse `1.10` as a floating number or collapse leading zeros.
Stop on sentinel/representation ambiguity, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect Type 0/tool identity, extract the minor component using the verified representation and compare exact integer/text semantics before/after reboot.
Do not infer it from the BIOS Version string, modify firmware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected component, sentinel and formatting rules plus recovery.
Resolve version-contract mismatches and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Fragile because installed dmidecode may render the components as `BIOS Revision`; the command also suppresses errors and assumes insecure transport.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 0 with tool version/errors, verify field rendering, and parse minor as a discrete component before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, minor-release scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record major/minor components separately, preserve any combined display and sentinel, and compare the exact minor component without floating-point conversion across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 0 revisions implementing System BIOS release fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode/script and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMBIOS field baseline and approved tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds component-safe parsing and sentinel/leading-zero handling.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected minor value and representation mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The marketing BIOS Version string may not encode the SMBIOS numeric minor component.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a numeric minor component or not-specified value. Any mapping to a branded BIOS version must be explicit.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected minor/sentinel rule, platform and tool versions
Raw pre-reboot Type 0 plus component mapping

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion consistently target the minor component; value/representation are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds minor-component and leading-zero semantics distinct from the adjacent major case.

review_improvement: Prevents wrong results from floating-point or marketing-version parsing and records sentinel applicability.
